text: Make favoring root-cause fixes a standing default. Add a BRIEF.md addendum dated 2026-10-13 that quotes Sri verbatim: 'Have Athena favor fixing root causes'. Add a defaults.toml entry citing it: when a request reports a failure, find where the fault originates and fix it there, rather than patching the symptom or the one instance that surfaced; when the root cause lies outside the request's scope, name it and propose the fix instead of silently working around it. Say how it relates to the existing 'small' default. The verifier must be able to check it: a fix's description names the root cause and why the change addresses it.
